company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited

kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 162 (NSE issue page). At Rs 162: market cap Rs 911.9 cr post-issue; P/E 23.4x on 9M FY26 PAT annualised (39.2x on FY25, before a full year of the merged business); P/B 2.49x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 11.8x annualised. Objects floor Rs 133.46.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow Rs -4.95 / -23.56 / -9.53 cr FY23-25 against PAT Rs 1.34 / 8.17 / 23.26 cr as inventory rose from Rs 44.81 cr to Rs 205.70 cr; 9M FY26 CFO +Rs 18.01 cr against PAT Rs 29.17 cr. Typical for a jewellery retailer stocking new showrooms; inventory days 122 -> 178 -> 205 (p. 101).

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Until 29-Mar-2025 the promoter ran a parallel proprietorship (M. K. Sons Jewellers), from which the company bought Rs 21.52 cr of goods in FY25; it was then merged in for 40,38,152 shares at Rs 176 (Rs 71.07 cr). Promoter loans (Rs 1.52 cr outstanding Dec-25) and showroom rent to the promoter (Rs 1.23 cr in 9M FY26) continue. Disclosed; the merger removes the overlap.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Five leased showrooms (3 Mumbai, 2 Ahmedabad; 6,513 sq ft); the two Ahmedabad showrooms gave 62.40% of 9M FY26 revenue. Finished jewellery is bought from third-party vendors in Maharashtra and Gujarat without long-term contracts.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -41.1% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: RED: objects floor sits above blended fair value

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: Bonus issues of 2:1 (16-May-2025) and 2:3 (Dec-2025) are reflected: EPS 0.60 / 3.63 / 10.26 FY23-25 and 6.83 for 9M FY26 are on the 4,26,90,760 post-bonus shares.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax about 27% of PBT each year; income tax paid Rs 12.46 cr over FY23-9M FY26.

comfort.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
comfort.detail: Objects Rs 181.51 cr (showroom inventory Rs 151.51 cr + debt repayment Rs 30.00 cr) over 1.36 crore fresh shares = Rs 133.46 a share before GCP and expenses, below the Rs 153 floor.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 4.995 cr of income-tax demands (3.4% of Dec-25 net worth); no criminal or regulatory cases.

comfort.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
comfort.detail: Paresh Rakesh & Associates LLP; FY23-25 restated from special-purpose Ind AS statements prepared from Indian GAAP books.

peers.name: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited at reference

overhang.label: Promoter holding above 20% of post-issue capital (after OFS)
Promoters' minimum contribution (20% of post-issue capital)

strengths: Revenue up from Rs 24.91 cr to Rs 351.28 cr in two years (p. 227)
EBITDA margin 13.36% and ROCE 26.84% in 9M FY26 (p. 101)
weaknesses: Short history as a combined entity (p. 189)
Young board; promoter family about 100% pre-issue (pp. 65-66, 78)
opportunities: New Maharashtra and expanded Ahmedabad showrooms in FY27 (p. 91)
Shift to organised hallmarked jewellery (p. 111 onwards)
threats: National chains in Mumbai and Ahmedabad (p. 100)

adjustments.item: Interest on security deposits (Ind AS 116 unwinding, in other income)
adjustments.reason: Notional interest on lease deposits; non-operating and immaterial.

adjustments.item: Promoter directors' pay at the FY26 run-rate
adjustments.reason: No remuneration was paid to the three promoter directors before FY25 (Rs 0.60 cr in FY25); the FY26 rate is Rs 1.65 cr a year. Normalising FY23-25 for it lowers profit; a choice, not an accounting entry. For information.

adjustments.item: Purchases from the promoter's proprietorship before its merger
adjustments.reason: Rs 21.52 cr of FY25 purchases came from M. K. Sons Jewellers (promoter's proprietorship) before it was merged in on 29-Mar-2025; pricing is not disclosed, so any effect on margin cannot be quantified. For information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY25 PAT by -0.1%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY23-FY25 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 83.5x reported and 83.6x adjusted.
flags: Notional interest on lease deposits; non-operating and immaterial.
checked: No capitalised costs: no capital work in progress, intangibles negligible (p. 226)
Ind AS processing-fee amortisation (Rs 0.93 cr in 9M FY26) is charged in finance cost (p. 228)
No exceptional items FY23 to 9M FY26 (p. 227)
Profit taxed in cash: current tax about 27% of PBT (p. 227)
Gross margin rose from 9.19% (FY24) to 14.51% (FY25) and 17.15% (9M FY26) while gold prices rose; inventory gains cannot be separated from the disclosures (p. 101)
Inventory is not hedged against gold prices (no hedging policy disclosed)
